recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-8327 unless a work group separately chooses to revisit the generic modifier reason wording for Procedure.status.
issue_request: FHIR-8327 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Procedure issue from the DSTU1 QICore ballot asking that base Procedure.status be listed as isModifier because negating status values such as aborted and entered-in-error were present.
initial_application: Jira comments say Mark Kramer planned to mark Procedure.status as modifying on 2015-07-27 and Lloyd McKenzie replied on 2015-08-27 that it had already been applied. Source history supports this: commit 140947a909 introduced Procedure.status with the old spreadsheet Is Modifier column set to Y, and the explicit issue-tagged commit d51bbbe626 (#8261, #8327, #8408) preserved that modifier row before later source migration.
additional_context: Procedure is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/procedure/structuredefinition-Procedure.xml is in current build scope. Later status wording changed from the DSTU1 aborted phrasing to current event-status codes including not-done, stopped, completed, entered-in-error, and unknown, but the current element still has isModifier=true and an isModifierReason. Focused Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later decision reversing or narrowing the modifier requirement.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative Procedure StructureDefinition already contains the requested modifier flag on Procedure.status, so changing source would be redundant.
